scenario_description: Lena needs to provide the dishwasher's model and serial information before a scheduled repair visit can proceed. Her existing maintenance guide contains the appliance details, but the prerequisite is not apparent until the repair is arranged. Early notice of a leak is not enough to justify intervention; once the repair company places the appointment on hold pending those details, an agent can materially help by locating the record and sending the information to the landlord and repair company before the appointment is lost.

parameter.subject: Dishwasher leak
parameter.body: The dishwasher left a small puddle under the front edge after last night's cycle. It is not leaking continuously, but I wanted to report it and ask whether you want a repair arranged.

parameter.subject: Re: Dishwasher leak
parameter.body: Thanks for reporting this. I arranged for North Star Appliance Repair to come to the townhouse on January 14 between 9:00 and 11:00 AM. They may need the dishwasher model and serial number before they can bring the right part.

parameter.subject: Dishwasher appointment on hold
parameter.body: Your January 14 service visit is on hold until we receive the dishwasher model and serial number. Please send both details by noon on January 12 so the technician can bring the likely replacement parts. Without them, the visit may need to be postponed.

parameter.subject: Dishwasher model information
parameter.body: North Star says they need the dishwasher model and serial number by January 12. I checked the front and inside edge but cannot find the label. Do you know where this information is recorded?

parameter.subject: Final information request for January 14
parameter.body: We still need the dishwasher model and serial number by noon tomorrow. If the information is not received, we will release the January 14 time window and schedule the repair after the details become available.

parameter.name: Mark Jensen
parameter.notes: Property owner for Lena Ortiz's Minneapolis townhouse.

parameter.name: North Star Appliance Repair
parameter.notes: Repair company used for the townhouse dishwasher visit.
